verdict.probe_answer: Arm A: yes. Arm B: yes. Both diagnose the gawk `load` builtin collision, make the minimal variable rename in `scripts/test-db/select_db_host.sh`, and leave `test/hooks.js` untouched.
verdict.rationale: Both arms make the same effective fix: avoid passing an awk variable named `load` via `-v`, which is what triggers gawk's builtin-name collision. Arm A renames it to `ld`; Arm B renames it to `load_avg`. Both are confined to the DB host selection script and do not touch the transaction/fixture hook code. Neither arm adds tests or materially improves validation over the other, so this is parity.
